decisions.decision: Town Counsel Adam Costa was given permission to draft a contract covering the purchase and sale, subject to permitting, the easement conveyance and procurement law, and to bring something forward before the next meeting.
decisions.quote: he requested permission to draft that document and try to bring something forward before the next meeting. they concurred.

decisions.decision: Toale and McQuaid stated they were qualified to vote under the Rule of Necessity despite possible proximity to the property; Ebersole did not object, and Adams agreed.
decisions.quote: invoked the rule of necessity as long as there were no objections by other board members.
